answer.reason: The verses state that Phinehas was slain with his brother Hophni when the ark was taken, and that a sign of this was foretold.

clauses.english: was slain with his brother Hophni when the Philistines took the ark of God
clauses.quote: the ark of God was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain

doubts: 1SA 2:34 foretells the death of both sons in one day; left out as it is the same event as the slaying in 1SA 4:11.
1SA 14:3 and 1SA 4:19 only give family relations, already in the summary.
